title: Voltara X100 inverter technical datasheet
summary: Efficiency, power rating, MPPT range and cooling for the X100 10 kW hybrid inverter.
body: Voltara X100 hybrid inverter. Peak efficiency 97.6%, EU efficiency 97.1%. Rated AC output 10 kW, max PV input 15 kW. Two MPPT trackers, range 160-850 V. Active fan cooling, IP65 enclosure, operating -25 to +60 °C.

title: Voltara X100 inverter grid and connector compatibility
summary: Grid codes, connector types and battery port specification for the X100.
body: Grid codes: VDE-AR-N 4105, EN 50549-1. DC connectors MC4-compatible. Single-phase 230 V and three-phase 400 V variants. Battery port 150-600 V with CAN and RS485.

title: Voltara X100 inverter warranty terms
summary: Standard and extended warranty terms for the X100 inverter.
body: Standard warranty 10 years, extendable to 15 or 20 years. Claims require the commissioning report and serial number. On-site swap within 72 hours in covered regions.

title: Voltara X100 inverter firmware release notes
summary: Latest firmware changes for the X100 inverter.
body: Firmware 2.8.1 (October 2026): better low-light MPPT tracking, faster grid reconnection after faults, fixes battery state-of-charge drift above 95%.

title: Voltara X200 inverter technical datasheet
summary: Power rating, efficiency and MPPT details for the X200 15 kW inverter.
body: Voltara X200 three-phase hybrid inverter. Rated AC output 15 kW, peak efficiency 98.0%, three MPPT trackers, range 180-900 V. IP66 enclosure.

title: Voltara B20 battery technical datasheet
summary: Capacity, cycle life and power figures for the B20 home battery.
body: Usable capacity 20.4 kWh (LFP). 6,000 cycles at 90% depth of discharge. 10 kW continuous discharge. Modular in 5.1 kWh stacks, up to 4 stacks per inverter.

title: Voltara B20 battery safety certification
summary: Safety standards and protection features of the B20 battery.
body: Tested to IEC 62619 and UN 38.3. LiFePO4 cells, pack-level thermal runaway protection, operating range -10 to +50 °C.

title: Lumen P450 solar panel datasheet
summary: Electrical and thermal data for the P450 450 Wp module.
body: 450 Wp mono PERC half-cut module. Module efficiency 21.3%. Temperature coefficient of Pmax -0.34%/°C, NOCT 43 °C. 25-year linear power warranty.

title: Voltara C9 site controller protocol guide
summary: Communication protocols and data models supported by the C9 controller.
body: Modbus TCP and RTU, SunSpec models 1, 103, 124 and 802. Minimum polling interval 1 s. Firmware 3.4 adds remote curtailment.

title: Voltara M3 roof mount dimensions and loads
summary: Dimensions and load ratings of the M3 roof mounting kit.
body: Rail length 1.2 m, anodized aluminium 6005-T5. Wind load up to 2.4 kPa, snow load up to 5.4 kPa. Hooks for tile and trapezoid roofs.

title: Voltara W11 EV wallbox datasheet
summary: Charging power, connectivity and solar modes of the W11 wallbox.
body: 11 kW three-phase AC wallbox with Type 2 socket. OCPP 1.6J, dynamic load balancing and a solar-surplus charging mode.

title: Voltara HP7 heat pump datasheet
summary: Seasonal efficiency, refrigerant and noise data for the HP7 heat pump.
body: 7 kW air-to-water heat pump. SCOP 4.6 at 35 °C flow, R290 refrigerant, outdoor sound pressure 48 dB(A) at 1 m.
